name: Binary Search
description: Locate a target in a sorted array by repeatedly halving the search range.

name: Maximum Subarray
description: Use Kadane's algorithm to find the largest sum of a contiguous subarray.

name: Container With Most Water
description: Use two pointers to maximize the area between two vertical heights.

name: Spiral Matrix
description: Traverse a matrix clockwise by shrinking its outer boundaries.

name: Rotate Image
description: Rotate a square matrix 90 degrees clockwise by transposing and reversing rows.

name: Set Matrix Zeroes
description: Set complete rows and columns to zero when any cell in them is zero.

name: Maximum Depth of Binary Tree
description: Compute a binary tree's maximum depth with recursive depth-first search.

name: Validate Binary Search Tree
description: Validate binary-search-tree ordering with recursive lower and upper bounds.

name: Binary Tree Level Order Traversal
description: Collect binary-tree values level by level with breadth-first search.

name: Valid Parentheses
description: Match every closing bracket with the latest unmatched opening bracket.

name: Daily Temperatures
description: Use a decreasing stack of indices to find the next warmer day.

name: Largest Rectangle in Histogram
description: Use an increasing stack to find the largest rectangle under a histogram.

name: Course Schedule
description: Detect whether all courses can be completed with Kahn's topological sort.

name: Sliding Window Maximum
description: Maintain a decreasing deque of indices to find each window's maximum.

name: Rotting Oranges
description: Use multi-source breadth-first search to spread rot through a grid.

name: Reverse Linked List
description: Reverse every next pointer in a singly linked list.

name: Linked List Cycle
description: Detect a linked-list cycle with Floyd's slow and fast pointers.

name: Merge Two Sorted Lists
description: Merge two sorted linked lists by relinking their existing nodes.

name: Two Sum
description: Use a map of seen values to locate two indices whose values sum to a target.

name: Group Anagrams
description: Group words by a canonical sorted-letter key stored in a map.

name: Longest Consecutive Sequence
description: Use the canonical map to find the longest run of consecutive integers in linear time.
